title: Rendering glitch with nested scrollbars and wrapped lines

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear description of a rendering glitch where wrapped output inside scrollable bordered tool boxes breaks out of the right border when vertical scrollbars are present. Environment and client details are provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: This is a localized UI layout fix in Ink components (ToolResultDisplay) where child width calculation needs to account for scrollbar padding in Scrollable.

summary.problem: Output rendered inside bounded tool call boxes breaks out of the right box border when content wraps and scrollbars are active.
summary.root_cause: ToolResultDisplay passes childWidth (calculated as terminalWidth - 4) to child renderers like MarkdownDisplay before enclosing them in Scrollable. Scrollable applies an inner right padding of 1 unit for the scrollbar gutter, reducing available inner content width to childWidth - 1. Because children are formatted for childWidth, wrapped lines and code blocks overflow the inner container by 1 column and breach the right border.
summary.context: When running in alternate buffer mode (ASB), tool results are rendered wrapped in a Scrollable container. Scrollable uses an inner Box with paddingRight={1} to reserve space for the vertical scrollbar.

steps: Adjust width calculation for child content in ToolResultDisplay when wrapped in Scrollable to subtract scrollbar padding (1 character).
Pass the adjusted content width to MarkdownDisplay, DiffRenderer, SubagentProgressDisplay, and other child renderers to ensure text wrapping and block widths align with Scrollable inner bounds.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Tool output rendered inside Scrollable containers stays strictly within the right border of the containing box without breaking out.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in ToolResultDisplay.test.tsx that renders long wrapping markdown content in alternate buffer mode inside a constrained width.
Verify that rendered output lines fit within the expected content width and do not exceed the box boundary.
